meta.title: 按授权范围读取事实，经统一语义归类与配对渲染多视角观测
meta.description: GET /api/tasks/:id/observation is a read-only task-truth projection. It uses the same complete projectKey/mode/taskId scope as semantic reads, takes admissions and committed public output from the selected project/mode Journal, and attaches Agent activity from the same scope. The query scope remains an observation subtree and node remains a selected observation node.
meta.prototypeBoundary: docs/ui/semantic-observation-tour.html is a standalone semantic Mock design; it does not consume or prove this production chain
meta.browserDesignContract: Shared semantic controls compose all views; declared events connect modules; immutable payload references are shared along data arcs; unknown/stale/empty and evidence remain explicit
meta.payloadReferenceStatus: candidate browser shared-reference contract; native Arc type and production wiring remain pending
meta.agentActivityContract: Task-scoped instance ownership is read from actual native bindings, acquired incarnations, resumed segments and owner-decoded Journal receipts. It reaches semantic projection through the direct task_projection arc; event normalization and role frames never generate or replace instance identity. actualExecutionGraph is a read-only field of the same successful projection.
meta.agentActivityOwner: packages/runtime/src/observation/agent-activity.ts selects exact typed ownership; packages/app/src/ui-runtime/agent-activity-read.ts reads existing owner decoders; packages/ui/projection/agent-activity.ts projects the same source; docs/ui/agent-activity.js renders it without control effects. The published task-scoped read slice is implemented and proven; cross-scope aggregation and live closure remain pending.
meta.actualExecutionGraphContract: The existing RuntimeAgentActivityProjection value is the only read carrier. Its successful value gains actualExecutionGraph, built from the same verified context.controlRecords by decoding committed graph facts, replaying each task/owner stream with Runtime's pure replay function, resolving existing Core guidance, and calling the UI source-to-view helper. No second endpoint, sibling top-level carrier, Manager creation, admission, acquire or rebind occurs on GET.
meta.actualExecutionGraphHistory: No graph fact is explicit missing recorded history, not a fabricated empty historical graph. Guidance, current plan and recorded assignment instances remain separate meanings; stage.parentNodeId, assignment membership, child lineage and the 13-node registry are never converted into execution dependencies.
meta.i2HistoryContract: Six I2 read contracts (inspection occurrences, inspection occurrence entry, milestone reviews, business cycles, business cycle entry and inspection comparison) are carried from load_task_truth to project_semantic_views on the direct task_projection arc. Each contract carries a task read scope identifying projectKey, mode and taskId. The scoped task read resolves that declared project and mode from configuration and reads its own Journal inventory; it never borrows the serve-bound project's Coordinator, task snapshot or Organ identity.
meta.semanticScopeContract: GET /api/tasks/:id/semantic and /api/tasks/:id/semantic/stream accept an optional complete projectKey and mode pair. Omitting both keeps the legacy serve-bound live Coordinator read. A complete non-bound scope reads the declared project and mode Journal inventory and projects the same runtime semantic envelope from durable events. A partial or invalid pair fails before streaming as read.scope.invalid; an unknown project fails as project.unknown; a task absent from that scope fails as task.not-found.
meta.observationScopeContract: GET /api/tasks/:id/observation accepts the same optional complete projectKey and mode pair. Omitting both keeps the synchronous serve-bound observation behavior. A complete scope resolves the declared project and mode before projection; a partial or invalid pair fails as read.scope.invalid, an unknown project as project.unknown, and an absent task as task.not-found. The scope query parameter is only the observation subtree ref, and node is only the selected node id.
meta.observationTruthContract: A scoped observation reads the task snapshot and admission history from the selected project/mode Journal, never from the serve-bound requirementAdmissions map. The task.output node uses only the authoritative committed public publication from the same scope. Missing, pending, unavailable or unknown publication stays explicit and is not replaced by record.output, provider text or model text; raw and action history remain available as evidence.
meta.observationAgentContract: The observation route decodes the existing agent, turn and item selection query with decodeTaskAgentActivitySelectionQuery. UiRuntimeService attaches readTaskAgentActivity from the same resolved project/mode source. It does not fabricate a bound Organ or borrow another project's Agent activity.
meta.foreignSemanticStreamContract: A non-bound durable semantic stream validates and reads its snapshot before writing the 200 text/event-stream headers, emits one semantic snapshot, then emits the transport event semantic-complete with empty JSON data and ends normally. It never subscribes to the serve-bound Coordinator. The completion event is a transport signal and does not alter the semantic payload or add business metadata.
meta.publicOutputContract: Durable task inventory restores record.publicOutput through the same FileCheckpointStore.readPublicOutputs reader used by the live coordinator. The binding keeps the task's business scope and selects the committed checkpoint execution epoch when the current operation has one, otherwise the operation allocation epoch. The read never falls back to record.output and never fabricates success; a read failure remains visible as unknown with any already retained commits.

terminalContract.failure: explicit stale/disconnected/unmapped projection; no raw inference or fake live state
terminalContract.blocked: scope, semantic coverage, project or agent identity unavailable is explicit
terminalContract.cleanup: read-only projection closes with no runtime mutation
